name: Dialpad
description: Dialpad cloud phone system as agent tools — 53 tools spanning calls & transcripts & AI recaps, call-center status & operators & callbacks, users, contacts, offices, departments, coaching teams, phone numbers, blocked numbers, dispositions, meetings, analytics/stats/scorecards/WFM, and SMS. Multi-tenant: each workspace connects its own Dialpad API key. Read-first (40 reads); 13 writes are individually flagged WRITE for RBAC gating.

tenantConfig.description: Per-tenant credentials each workspace enters when it subscribes. The platform stores them on the tenant's Subscription and forwards them per-request as X-Mcp-Tenant-Cred-<Field> headers (api_key -> X-Mcp-Tenant-Cred-Api-Key). Nothing is shared across tenants.

api_key.title: Dialpad API key
api_key.description: Company API key from Dialpad → Admin Settings → Company Settings → API keys. Auth is Authorization: Bearer <key>.

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List Dialpad users (name, email, office, on-duty / online status). Optionally filter by email or state.

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Get one Dialpad user's full details by user id.

tools.name: get_user_caller_ids
tools.description: List the caller-ID numbers a user is allowed to present on outbound calls.

tools.name: toggle_user_dnd
tools.description: Turn Do-Not-Disturb on or off for a user. WRITE — gate with approval in Eesa RBAC.

tools.name: initiate_call
tools.description: Ring a Dialpad user's device and place an outbound call to a phone number (click-to-call). WRITE — gate with approval in Eesa RBAC.

tools.name: list_calls
tools.description: List concluded call records (call history). Filter by time window (unix ms) or a target user/office/department/call-center id.

tools.name: get_call
tools.description: Get the full details of a single call by call id.

tools.name: get_call_transcript
tools.description: Get the transcript of a call by call id (when transcription is enabled for the workspace).

tools.name: get_call_ai_recap
tools.description: Get the AI recap (summary, action items, purposes) for a call by call id, when Ai is enabled.

tools.name: get_call_operators
tools.description: List the operators currently assigned to a live call.

tools.name: add_call_labels
tools.description: Attach one or more labels/tags to a call. WRITE — gate with approval in Eesa RBAC.

tools.name: hangup_call
tools.description: Hang up (end) a live call by call id. WRITE — gate with approval in Eesa RBAC.

tools.name: create_call_review_sharelink
tools.description: Create a shareable review link for a recorded call. WRITE — gate with approval in Eesa RBAC.

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts in the Dialpad company address book. Optionally restrict to one owner.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by contact id.

tools.name: create_contact
tools.description: Create a shared/company contact. WRITE — gate with approval in Eesa RBAC.

tools.name: update_contact
tools.description: Update fields on an existing contact. WRITE — gate with approval in Eesa RBAC.

tools.name: delete_contact
tools.description: Delete a contact by id. WRITE / destructive — gate with approval in Eesa RBAC.

tools.name: list_departments
tools.description: List the departments (groups) in the Dialpad company.

tools.name: get_department
tools.description: Get one department by id.

tools.name: list_department_operators
tools.description: List the operators (agents) assigned to a department.

tools.name: list_offices
tools.description: List the offices in the Dialpad company.

tools.name: get_office
tools.description: Get one office by id.

tools.name: get_office_plan
tools.description: Get the billing plan (licenses purchased / used) for an office.

tools.name: list_office_operators
tools.description: List the mainline operators for an office.

tools.name: list_call_centers
tools.description: List the call centers (support queues) in the company.

tools.name: get_call_center
tools.description: Get one call center by id.

tools.name: get_call_center_status
tools.description: Get the live operational status of a call center (queue depth, on-duty agents, wait times).

tools.name: list_call_center_operators
tools.description: List the operators (agents) staffed on a call center.

tools.name: set_operator_duty_status
tools.description: Set a call-center agent's on/off-duty status. WRITE — gate with approval in Eesa RBAC.

tools.name: list_callbacks
tools.description: List queued callbacks for a call center.

tools.name: enqueue_callback
tools.description: Request a callback: add a phone number to a call center callback queue. WRITE — gate with approval in Eesa RBAC.

tools.name: list_coaching_teams
tools.description: List coaching teams (supervisor ↔ agent groupings).

tools.name: get_coaching_team
tools.description: Get one coaching team by id.

tools.name: list_coaching_team_members
tools.description: List the members of a coaching team.

tools.name: list_phone_numbers
tools.description: List the phone numbers provisioned in the Dialpad company (with assignment targets).

tools.name: get_phone_number
tools.description: Get details for a specific phone number (assignment, office, status).

tools.name: format_phone_number
tools.description: Normalise / validate a phone number into E.164 and local formats for a country.

tools.name: list_rooms
tools.description: List Dialpad rooms (shared spaces / desk-phone rooms) in an office.

tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: List messaging channels in the company.

tools.name: list_blocked_numbers
tools.description: List numbers blocked company-wide from calling/texting in.

tools.name: block_number
tools.description: Block one or more inbound numbers company-wide. WRITE — gate with approval in Eesa RBAC.

tools.name: unblock_number
tools.description: Remove one or more numbers from the company block list. WRITE — gate with approval in Eesa RBAC.

tools.name: list_dispositions
tools.description: List call dispositions (outcome codes) configured for the company.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Get the Dialpad company profile (name, plan, admin, domains).

tools.name: list_sms_opt_outs
tools.description: List numbers that have opted out of SMS from the company (compliance / do-not-text list).

tools.name: list_meetings
tools.description: List Dialpad Meetings.

tools.name: list_scheduled_messages
tools.description: List SMS messages scheduled to send in the future.

tools.name: send_sms
tools.description: Send an SMS text message from a Dialpad user to one or more numbers. WRITE — gate with approval in Eesa RBAC.

tools.name: request_call_stats
tools.description: Kick off an async analytics export (call/text volume, durations, etc.) over a day range. Returns a request_id — then poll get_stats_result until it is ready.

tools.name: get_stats_result
tools.description: Fetch the result of a previously requested analytics export by its request_id (from request_call_stats).

tools.name: list_scorecards
tools.description: List QA scorecards configured for the company (agent call scoring rubrics).

tools.name: get_wfm_agent_metrics
tools.description: Get workforce-management agent metrics (adherence, occupancy, productivity) over a day range.

roles.label: Dialpad Admin
roles.description: Full access: query calls, transcripts, analytics and the whole directory, plus the write actions (send SMS, place/hang up calls, edit contacts, block numbers, set agent duty status, request callbacks).

roles.label: Viewer
roles.description: Read-only: calls, transcripts, AI recaps, analytics, users, contacts, offices, departments, call centers and phone numbers. No write actions.
